papers.title_en: Residual Motion Splatting for Continuous Space-Time Video Super-Resolution
papers.authors: Vincent Herfeld, Eva Coupet{é}, Julien Mairal, Jean Ponce
papers.evidence: 基于残差运动泼溅的连续时空视频超分辨率
papers.tldr: 连续时空视频超分需从低分辨率低帧率视频重建任意尺度与时刻的高清高帧率结果。现有学习方法常在融合前重采样，导致亚像素信息丢失。本文提出残差运动溅射，先预测逐像素连续轨迹，再将连续低分辨率特征按亚像素位置和可见性权重直接溅射到高分辨率网格，并统一时序插值与多帧超分。在多个基准上提升保真度和感知质量，且最高快一个数量级。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous space-time video super-resolution produces a high-resolution, highframe-rate video from a low-resolution, low-frame-rate one at arbitrary spatial scales and temporal instants. Classical spatial multi-frame super-resolution has shown that detail beyond a single frame's sampling limit can be recovered by aligning complementary observations with sub-pixel precision and accumulating them on a finer grid. Existing learning-based methods largely depart from this principle: some align and fuse frames only at low resolution before regressing a continuous high-resolution representation, while others interpolate each frame to the output resolution before splatting. In both cases, the per-frame samples are resampled before fusion, so their sub-pixel positions are lost before frames are combined. Restoring this principle in a learned continuous model raises two challenges: estimating sub-pixel motion at unobserved times, and handling holes and occlusions when splatting a coarse grid onto a finer one. We address the first by predicting per-pixel continuous trajectories that refine linear optical-flow paths with smooth residual motion, using features integrated over the full video sequence. We address the second by directly splatting consecutive low-resolution features in a learned latent space onto a high-resolution grid at their predicted sub-pixel positions with predicted visibility weights, before a decoder resolves remaining ambiguities. This makes temporal interpolation and multi-frame superresolution a single operation. Our method improves both reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality on multiple standard benchmarks over the state of the art, while running up to an order of magnitude faster.

papers.title_en: DeCoRL: Decomposed Consistency Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Image Composition
papers.authors: Zhiqiang Wu, Shuang Sun, Jiale Zhang, Jing Li, Yibo Chen, Xu Tang, Yao Hu
papers.evidence: 强化学习提升图像编辑模型多图合成一致性
papers.tldr: 多图组合中参考图增多会致一致性快速下降，SFT仅提供隐式监督且难学可靠物体级对应。DeCoRL将整体一致性分解为物体级一致性，建立指令相关物体对应并定位生成区域，用VLM奖励模型给出逐物体反馈并聚合为多物体奖励指导RL后训练。在DeCo-Bench与MICo-Bench上一致性稳定提升，并发布覆盖2至6张参考图的基准，为多图组合提供可扩展的RL后训练与评测方案。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-image composition (MICo) is a critical yet challenging capability for large-scale image editing models, where consistency degrades rapidly as the number of reference images increases. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip models with basic MICo ability, it provides only implicit supervision on the composed image and often fails to learn reliable object-level correspondence across multiple references. We propose DeCoRL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that improves MICo consistency by decomposing holistic MICo consistency into object-level consistency. DeCoRL first establishes instruction-relevant object correspondences across reference images and localizes the corresponding regions in the generated image. It then uses a VLM-based reward model trained on single-object consistency annotations to produce fine-grained, object-wise feedback, which is aggregated into a multi-object consistency reward to guide RL post-training. We further introduce DeCo-Bench, a benchmark covering compositions from 2 to 6 reference images. Experiments on DeCo-Bench and the public MICo-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements in MICo consistency.

papers.authors: Haiyang Xu, Tianyu Wang, Jialu Li, Jiteng Mu, Yuanjun Xiong, Jianming Zhang, Zhuowen Tu, Mingze Xu
papers.evidence: 智能体图像编辑框架，扩展动作与观测空间并引入验证记录
papers.tldr: 智能体图像编辑器在单步失败后往往只会用同一套窄工具重试，且评判器仅凭肉眼打分，效果受限于动作空间与观测空间。EditAgent 将每步路由到通用编辑器与专用方法，并为每个候选生成验证记录，再以并行生成、单次 listwise 调用的方式由现成 VLM 评判。在专家标注基准上，专家在 78.5% 的有效比较中更偏好该方案，评判调用量不超过一半。它在三个基准上提升两个开源编辑器，并可作为训练更强编辑器的数据引擎。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic image editors decompose complex requests into steps, but when a step fails, they mostly retry with the same narrow set of tools and a judge that scores each output by eye directly. We argue that such agents are bounded by two spaces: the action space of what the agent can do, and the observation space of what its judge can see. On our expert-annotated benchmark, a general-purpose editor yields no usable result in over 40% of the cases, and no judge is reliable across edit types. We present EditAgent, which expands both spaces. It routes each step to general editors and specialized methods, and attaches to each candidate a verification record. With these records, off-the-shelf VLM judges outperform finetuned reward models. Candidates are generated in parallel and judged in one listwise call: experts prefer this to sequential refinement in 78.5% of decided comparisons, at no more than half the judge calls. EditAgent improves two open-weight editors on three benchmarks and serves as a data engine for training stronger editors.

papers.title_en: UniRA: Unified Representation Alignment and Auto-Encoding for Efficient Diffusion Generation
papers.authors: An Lanji, Dawei Liu, Jin Li, Haoran Xu, Mei Chen, Yu Tian
papers.evidence: 统一表示对齐与表示自编码以加速扩散Transformer图像生成
papers.tldr: 扩散Transformer（DiT）训练收敛慢、计算开销大。已有工作分别用REPA做表征对齐加速训练、用RAE把像素VAE换成表征空间分词器，但二者彼此孤立。UniRA把表征对齐与表征自编码统一到单一目标：学到的分词器输出同时充当扩散目标和表征对齐锚点，使分词器、扩散主干与外部分表征模型联合优化。在ImageNet 256×256与512×512上FID匹配或超过SD3、REPA、RAE，训练步数最多减少5倍。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image synthesis, yet they suffer from slow training convergence and high computational cost. Two recent lines of work address this from complementary angles: Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates DiT training by aligning intermediate features with a pretrained external representation model (e.g., DINOv2), while Representation Auto-Encoders (RAE) replace the pixel-space VAE with a compact representation-space tokenizer learned from self-supervised features. However, these approaches are developed and applied in isolation: REPA still relies on a pixel-space VAE for latent diffusion, and RAE does not exploit the alignment signal that accelerates the diffusion backbone. We present \textbf{UniRA}, a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective. UniRA learns a representation-space tokenizer whose output serves simultaneously as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so the tokenizer, the diffusion backbone, and the external representation model are co-optimized. We give a theoretical result showing that this joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model while accelerating diffusion convergence, and we derive a principled weighting that balances the reconstruction, alignment, and generation objectives. On ImageNet class-conditional generation at 256*256 and 512*512, UniRA matches or surpasses state-of-the-art DiTs (SD3, REPA, RAE) in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5*. We further show that the unified representation space supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a shared, aligned latent space.

papers.title_en: EditDistill: Is It Possible to Guide Video Editing with Image Editing?
papers.authors: Guojun Lei, Hong Li, Hongbing Yang, Lixue Gong, Chi Wang, Zheng Dong
papers.evidence: 蒸馏图像编辑变换以引导视频编辑
papers.tldr: 视频编辑在局部精确修改、动态时序效果和跨帧光照一致性上仍难达到图像编辑的可控性。EditDistill 先用现成图像编辑模型编辑首帧，再将原图与编辑图对的视觉变换蒸馏为紧凑编辑描述符，并通过轻量融合模块注入视频扩散模型以引导去噪。方法结合编辑描述符对齐与 DINO 结构一致性损失，并在流匹配下推导等价推理引导。实验在标准基准取得强性能，多场景生成高质量编辑视频，证明以图像编辑指导视频编辑可行。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in image editing have enabled fine-grained and highly controllable visual modifications. However, achieving similar levels of controllability in video editing remains an open challenge, particularly for precise local edits, dynamic temporal effects, and consistent lighting across frames.In this paper, we propose EditDistill, a framework that distills image-level visual transformations from edits to guide video editing.Specifically, given a source video and an edit prompt, we first generate an edited version of the initial video frame using an off-the-shelf image editing model. We then distill the visual transformation of this original-edited image pair into a compact representation termed an edit descriptor.This descriptor is injected into a video diffusion model through our lightweight fusion module, which steers the denoising process toward the desired edit. To align the video trajectory with the demonstrated image edit while preserving motion and layout, we train with edit-descriptor alignment and DINO structural consistency losses, and derive an equivalent inference-time guidance formulation under flow matching.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves strong performance on standard benchmarks and produces high-quality video editing results across diverse scenarios. For more details and videos, please refer to the anonymous webpage: https://yu-shaonian.github.io/EditDistill-Web/.

papers.title_en: Shared-Factor-Conditioned Diffusion for Low-Rank Tensor Recovery
papers.authors: Zhengyun Cheng, Guanwen Zhang, Wei Zhou
papers.evidence: 坐标条件扩散统一张量补全、去噪与高光谱超分辨率
papers.tldr: 张量恢复横跨多种数据结构与观测过程，亟需可跨模态、跨任务适配的统一表示。DiffTR提出无监督坐标条件扩散框架，用张量坐标索引的共享因子条件化紧凑评分网络，通过评分匹配联合学习共享因子与隐式张量表示，并将表示学习与任务观测建模分离。该框架统一处理张量补全、混合噪声去噪和高光谱超分辨，实验显示其重建质量具竞争力且灵活，为统一条件生成恢复提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Tensor recovery spans heterogeneous data structures and observation processes, calling for a representation that can adapt across modalities and tasks. We propose DiffTR, an unsupervised framework that unifies tensor completion, denoising, and hyperspectral super-resolution through coordinate-conditioned diffusion. Shared factors indexed by tensor coordinates condition a compact score network, and score matching jointly learns the factors and an implicit tensor representation from the available observations. Scalar and vector-valued outputs accommodate individual entries and entire tubes, enabling a common formulation for tabular tensors, images, and videos. The framework separates representation learning from task-specific observation modeling: reverse diffusion recovers missing values; estimation via Tweedie's formula, soft thresholding, and optional spatial consistency support mixed-noise denoising; and measurement-guided sampling transfers a prior learned from low-resolution hyperspectral observations to high-resolution reconstruction, followed by post-sampling refinement with data consistency and spectral subspace regularization. This separation makes the representation compatible with different corruption models and permits task-specific constraints to be incorporated within the same recovery framework. Experiments across multiple tensor modalities and recovery tasks demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and the flexibility of a unified conditional generative representation. The code is available at https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR

papers.title_en: Visual Autoregressive Generation with Next Token Imagination
papers.authors: Ruihang Jiang, Zongyao Zhao, Zhaolin Wang, Yuanwei Liu, Xiatian Zhu
papers.tldr: 视觉内容空间巨大而训练数据有限，视觉自回归模型通常只拟合真实下一token，难以覆盖完整视觉分布。作者提出Next Token Imagination（NTI），在受视觉分布约束的准则下允许模型探索真实token之外的合理视觉实现。在ImageNet上，NTI持续提升生成图像保真度，以更小模型和更低训练成本逼近先进扩散与AR模型。该工作说明让模型在训练数据之外进行有界想象，可增强视觉生成能力。
papers.abstract_en: The space of possible visual content is enormous, and arguably unbounded. Any training set, however large, therefore covers only a tiny fraction of it. Yet generative models are typically trained to fit only the images they are given. In visual autoregressive (AR) generation, for example, each token is predicted from the preceding ground-truth (GT) tokens and supervised solely by the GT next token. Confining learning to observed data in this way limits how much of the visual distribution a model can capture. In this work, we hypothesize that letting a model imagine beyond its training data, by exploring plausible visual realizations it has never observed, can ease this limitation. We use visual AR generation as a proof of concept, since its fixed, discrete token space makes imagination easier to steer and constrain. We propose Next Token Imagination (NTI), a method that allows the model to explore beyond the GT next token, subject to a carefully designed criterion that keeps this imagination bounded by the underlying visual distribution. Extensive experiments on ImageNet show that NTI substantially and consistently improves the fidelity of generated images, approaching state-of-the-art diffusion and AR models while using a smaller model and lower training cost.

papers.title_en: Efficient Covariance-Aware Vicinal Latent Diffusion for Continuous Conditional Image Generation
papers.authors: Xin Ding, Shuo Huang, Zhenglong Ding, Sen Zhang, Nenglun Chen, Peibei Cao, Yongwei Wang, Fei Wu
papers.evidence: 面向连续条件图像生成的高效潜扩散
papers.tldr: 连续条件生成在标签不均衡和长尾分布下易出现数据稀疏、视觉伪影与条件不一致，且推理端无分类器引导和像素空间积分带来高开销。CAViLD构建净化后的条件感知潜空间，通过密度自适应邻域学习、辅助语义正则与NIQE引导负数据增强，并用EMA教师内化引导方向实现单分支推理。进一步提出协方差感知渐进蒸馏，支持低至4次NFE采样。在RC-49、UTKFace和Steering Angle上取得生成保真度、连续条件一致性与采样效率的较好权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous Conditional Generative Modeling (CCGM) aims to synthesize high-dimensional data conditioned on continuously valued scalar labels. However, existing continuous diffusion models face severe data sparsity under imbalanced and long-tailed label distributions, which can lead to visual artifacts and condition inconsistency. Moreover, inference-time classifier-free guidance and dense pixel-space integration introduce substantial sampling overhead, limiting practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose CAViLD, an efficient latent diffusion framework for continuous conditional generation. CAViLD first constructs a purified condition-aware latent space through density-adaptive vicinal learning, auxiliary semantic regularization, and NIQE-guided negative data augmentation. It then internalizes the conditional guidance direction through an EMA teacher, enabling single-branch conditional inference, and introduces covariance-aware progressive distillation for label-dependent probability-flow ODEs, supporting sampling down to four NFEs. Experiments on RC-49, UTKFace, and Steering Angle demonstrate a favorable trade-off among generation fidelity, continuous condition consistency, and sampling efficiency.

papers.title_en: AegisFlow: Training-Free Non-Myopic Path-Safe Guided Flow Matching
papers.authors: Kunpeng Liu, Boshi Zhang, Keyou You
papers.evidence: 面向受约束编辑的扩散与流匹配模型免训练引导
papers.tldr: 预训练扩散与流匹配模型生成质量突出，但无训练引导仍难让整条生成轨迹严格满足身份保持、避障等约束。现有方法多依赖最小范数控制器，只看当前约束，易贴近边界而限制目标优化。AegisFlow把引导生成重构为具有全局视野的安全最优控制问题，将时变障碍函数嵌入全局代价，并给出可计算的HJB近似求解。文本图像编辑与机器人规划实验显示，其在目标对齐和约束满足间取得更优平衡。
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained generative models, such as diffusion and flow matching models, have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in synthesizing high-quality data. However, steering their generative trajectories to satisfy strict constraints--such as identity preservation in image editing or obstacle avoidance in robotics--remains fundamentally challenging. While recent training-free guidance methods enforce path-safety, they rely heavily on min-norm controllers that only account for immediate constraint satisfaction. These myopic approaches often yield suboptimal trajectories that hover dangerously close to the boundary, severely restricting the model's ability to optimize toward its target. In this paper, we propose AegisFlow, a training-free, non-myopic path-safe guidance framework that recasts guided generation as a safety-critical optimal control problem with global scope. By integrating a time-varying barrier function directly into the global cost functional, AegisFlow naturally enforces constraints along the entire generative path. To compute the global optimal control, we derive a tractable, mathematically grounded approximation of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that AegisFlow outperforms state-of-the-art methods across text-guided image manipulation and robotic planning, establishing a significantly better trade-off between target alignment and constraint satisfaction. Code is available at https://github.com/LiuKunpeng03/AegisFlow.

papers.title_en: Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors
papers.evidence: 通过Feynman-Kac校正器组合与操控预训练扩散模型
papers.tldr: 扩散模型常需从多个预训练模型组合并带奖励倾斜的目标分布采样，但直接相加分数会产生错误样本，现有修正仅限特定目标族。本文提出广义Feynman-Kac校正器GFKC，构造初始函数到目标函数的几何插值并推导闭式势，同时推广对数概率ODE以沿不同速度场轨迹跟踪各模型密度。算法完全在对数域运行，可在线校正且无需重训或微调，并自然支持奖励引导。在高斯解析模型上接近真值目标，在MNIST上实现非平凡模型组合与有效引导。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm in generative modeling, yet many applications require sampling from distributions that are not those of any single pretrained model, but are instead defined through combinations of several models, possibly tilted toward high values of a downstream reward. Naively combining the scores of the models yields incorrect samples, while existing corrections are restricted to specific families of targets. In this work, we introduce the generalized Feynman-Kac correctors (GFKC), a principled framework for sampling from an arbitrary target function of several pretrained diffusion models. We show that the geometric interpolation between an arbitrary initial function and the target function of the models satisfies a Feynman--Kac partial differential equation, and derive its potential in closed form. To evaluate this potential during generation, we further generalize the log-probability ODE to track the density of each model along trajectories driven by a different velocity field. The resulting algorithm operates entirely in the log domain, incorporates reward-based steering at no additional conceptual cost, and corrects the generation on the fly, without retraining or fine-tuning the models. We validate the method on analytic Gaussian models, where it closely matches the ground-truth targets, and on diffusion models trained on MNIST, where it samples from non-trivial combinations of the models and enables effective steering.

papers.title_en: SREdit: Scene Response Guided Appearance Editing for Projection Mapping
papers.authors: Yuqiao Xia, Yuchen Deng, Ziheng Chang, Bingyao Huang
papers.evidence: 利用场景响应引导的预训练图像编辑模型实现投影映射外观编辑
papers.tldr: 投影映射外观编辑需先由图像编辑器生成目标外观，再用投影补偿还原，但通用编辑器缺乏场景几何与响应信息，易产生错位、阴影不一致和超出投影范围的问题。SREdit 从重建场景估计场景响应图，衡量投影光对不同表面的影响强度，并用源外观约束早期采样以保持配准、按响应自适应调节编辑量。实验在两种预训练编辑器上提升投影外观质量与复现保真度，每图耗时不足1秒且显存开销可忽略，用户研究也更偏好其结果。
papers.abstract_en: Projection-based appearance editing changes selected visual attributes of a physical object through projection mapping (PM). To display a desired appearance, PM typically uses projector compensation, which computes a projector input that counteracts the geometric and photometric distortions of the scene. Compensation can only approximate this appearance within the available projection range, and it cannot revise the appearance itself. Pretrained LLM-based image editors provide a direct way to produce the desired appearance from a text prompt or reference image; projector compensation can then attempt to reproduce the edited result through projection. However, these editors do not have an accurate measure of the scene geometry or scene response. Therefore, their outputs may contain geometric misalignment, inconsistent shading, or changes outside the available projection range, which downstream projector compensation cannot correct. To address this problem, we introduce SREdit, an efficient response-guided framework for projection-based appearance editing. SREdit estimates a scene response map from the reconstructed scene that reflects how strongly projected illumination can affect different surface regions. SREdit uses the source appearance to constrain the early sampling process and preserve registration with the fixed physical object, while the scene response map adapts the amount of editing across surface regions. Experiments across two pretrained image editors show that SREdit improves projected appearance quality and reproduction fidelity. It adds less than one second per image with negligible VRAM overhead. Participants also consistently preferred the results produced with SREdit in our user study.

papers.title_en: VidEdit3D: Flexible 3D Gaussian Editing with Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Yanming Yang, Chenxi Song, Tong Zhao, Juntao Xu, Wenhao Rao, Yiwen Chen, Yiwei Wang, Chi Zhang
papers.evidence: 视频扩散用于三维场景编辑
papers.tldr: 文本引导的3D高斯编辑虽具潜力，但难兼顾多视角一致性与结构修改，图像编辑器对非常规视角也易失效。VidEdit3D将3D场景编辑重构为轨迹视频编辑，借助视频扩散模型的时空先验传播锚点编辑。它用轨迹引导渲染选取关键帧并构建视频片段，以流对齐视频编辑和编辑一致性引导保持原场景上下文。实验表明其指令对齐与多视图一致性优于基线，为灵活3D编辑提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in text-guided 3D editing, particularly with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), have shown promise but still lag behind the flexibility of 2D editing tools. Existing methods face a critical trade-off between preserving multi-view consistency and allowing structural modifications. Image-based editors can also struggle to apply the intended edit to objects viewed from unusual angles. To address these limitations, we introduce VidEdit3D, a framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task. By drawing a parallel between camera movement in static 3D scenes and temporal dynamics in video, we leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to encourage semantic and structural coherence across views. Specifically, we propose Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) to select informative keyframes and construct smooth video clips aligned with VDM input requirements. To propagate edits from an anchor view to these clips, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free framework incorporating an Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG) mechanism. ECG contrasts source and edited image conditions at a shared latent state, using scheduled source-image amplification to strengthen adherence to the edited reference while maintaining original scene context. Finally, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS) to strictly confine geometric and appearance updates to target primitives, reducing background attribute leakage. Experiments demonstrate stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than the baselines.

papers.title_en: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation
papers.authors: Shufan Li, Hanrong Ye, Greg Heinrich, Yonggan Fu, Haotian Zhang, Sifei Liu, Aditya Grover, Pavlo Molchanov
papers.evidence: 用于视觉理解与生成的统一离散扩散大模型
papers.tldr: 统一扩散大模型难以同时继承自回归VLM的理解力与连续流模型的生成力。NLD-Uni提出跨范式在线策略蒸馏，将两类能力迁移到统一离散扩散LLM。其渐进式自精炼扩散在训练中多步腐化token，推理时可中间提交并逐步优化图像质量。实验在VQA、多模态推理、定位、文生图和图像编辑上达到统一DLLM的最优表现。
papers.abstract_en: We propose Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni (NLD-Uni), a unified discrete diffusion large language model (DLLM) for visual understanding and generation tasks. Compared with prior unified diffusion models, NLD-Uni introduces two major innovations. First, we propose a unified cross-paradigm on-policy distillation (OPD) framework that successfully transfers the visual understanding ability of autoregressive VLMs and visual generation ability of continuous flow models, to a unified DLLM. Second, NLD-Uni incorporates a novel progressive self-refining diffusion process that gradually corrupts each token across multiple steps during training, as opposed to adopting the conventional masked diffusion formulation that directly corrupts a clean image token to an uninformative mask token. At inference, this design allows NLD-Uni to make intermediate commit to a token, enabling progressive self-refinement for better visual quality. Through extensive experiments, we show that NLD-Uni achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified DLLMs on diverse tasks including visual question-answering, multi-modal reasoning, object grounding, text-to-image generation, and image editing.

papers.title_en: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
papers.authors: Yijing Lin, Zhendong Mao, Mengqi Huang, Yuxin Wang, Yongdong Zhang
papers.evidence: 利用视频基础模型先验的统一条件图像生成
papers.tldr: 统一条件图像生成要求单模型在遵循文本的同时保留输入不同方面，预训练视频模型虽有潜力，却常把条件与目标固定在固定时间位置。FrameForge 将条件生成建模为输入自适应的虚拟时间关系：MoTE 动态选择不同虚拟间隔的时间RoPE专家，CoTR 通过潜中间状态和推理瓶颈注意力建模变换。在 DreamBench、COCO2017 与 GEdit-Bench 上，该方法在主体驱动生成、canny-to-image 和图像编辑中表现更优。其贡献在于用视频先验统一多种条件生成任务。
papers.abstract_en: Unified conditional image generation requires a single model to preserve different aspects of a visual input while producing a target image that follows textual guidance. Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions. We observe that condition-target relationships vary substantially across generation tasks, while video models naturally encode visual transformations at different temporal scales. This motivates us to model conditional generation through input-adaptive virtual temporal relations. We propose FrameForge, which captures two complementary aspects of such relations. Mixture of Temporal Experts (MoTE) models how far the target lies from the condition by dynamically selecting temporal RoPE experts with different virtual intervals. Chain of Temporal Reasoning (CoTR) models how the condition is transformed into the target through a latent intermediate state, with a reasoning-bottleneck attention mask encouraging information propagation through this pathway. Experiments on DreamBench, COCO2017, and GEdit-Bench show that FrameForge achieves superior performance in subject-driven generation, canny-to-image generation, and image editing among the compared methods.

papers.title_en: Patch-Derived or Register Tokens? Comparing Variable-Length Image Tokenizers
papers.authors: Philipp Schenkel, Tobias Schürmann, Omer Sahin Tas
papers.evidence: 面向高效生成建模的可变长度图像分词器比较
papers.tldr: 图像tokenizer通常将latent排成下采样二维网格，使序列长度受分辨率约束。本文比较两种可变长度策略：计算高效的patch-derived token与无预设空间布局的register token，并在重建和下游生成任务上评估。极端压缩时patch-derived重建明显更优，中等预算register略好，高预算两者相近；下游生成register更强，而加入外部视觉编码器表示对齐后patch-derived可匹配或超过register。研究还揭示二者分别保留显式与形成隐式二维空间结构，为变长tokenizer设计提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Image tokenizers convert pixels into compact latent sequences for efficient generative modeling. Most approaches arrange latents on a downsampled two-dimensional grid, tying sequence length to image resolution. We compare two variable-length strategies: computationally efficient patch-derived tokens, which inherit explicit spatial organization, and more demanding register tokens, which have no predefined spatial layout. Our reconstruction results reveal that patch-derived tokens perform substantially better under extreme compression, whereas register tokens achieve slightly better reconstruction quality at intermediate budgets. At high token budgets, both approaches achieve similar reconstruction quality. For downstream generative tasks, register tokens outperform patch-derived tokens. Adding representation alignment with external pretrained visual encoders substantially improves the generative performance of patch-derived tokens, allowing them to match or outperform register tokens depending on the token budget. We further find that both approaches learn spatially localized representations. Patch-derived tokens largely retain their explicitly imposed spatial organization, while register tokens develop an implicit two-dimensional spatial structure despite having no predefined layout. Representation alignment reduces this spatial organizational constraint, enabling individual tokens to exert a stronger non-local influence.

papers.authors: Baiyu Su, Runlong Liao, Lizhang Chen, Qiang Liu
papers.evidence: 基于矫正流与扩散的生成建模
papers.tldr: 连续状态流与扩散模型有望实现快速并行的语言生成，但其生成质量仍难以匹敌自回归模型。ReLF 用整流流把噪声传输到 token 嵌入，并结合 Hellinger-SVD 固定嵌入、自条件引导与正则化 reflow，同时引入奇异 logits 兼顾有效嵌入约束与上下文偏好。在 OpenWebText 上以 64 次函数评估取得低于自回归基线的生成困惑度，两轮 reflow 后仅用 16 次评估仍保持优势，且 1024 token 序列生成快 15-19 倍。
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-state flow and diffusion models offer a promising approach to fast, parallel language generation, but matching the generation quality of autoregressive models remains challenging. We present Rectified Language Flow (ReLF), a language model that generates text by transporting noise to token embeddings using rectified flow. ReLF combines several complementary design choices: fixed token embeddings constructed with Hellinger-SVD, self-conditioning guidance trained with cross-entropy, and regularized reflow for few-step generation. We further introduce singular logits, which combine an analytically computed term that drives commitment to a valid token embedding as noise vanishes with a bounded neural residual that learns contextual token preferences. With 64 function evaluations on OpenWebText, ReLF achieves lower generative perplexity than autoregressive baselines at matched diversity across all three model sizes tested, while also outperforming prior continuous flow methods in this setting. After two reflow rounds, ReLF still outperforms autoregressive baselines with 16 function evaluations while generating 1,024-token sequences 15-19 times faster at batch size 1.

papers.title_en: Intrinsic Gradient Barriers in Pushforward Deep Generative Models
papers.authors: Edric Tam, Qingyang Liu, Barbara Engelhardt, Ray Bai
papers.evidence: 对推前深度生成模型及其分布匹配局限进行理论分析。
papers.tldr: 推前深度生成模型需将简单源分布映射到复杂目标分布，但重尾与分离多峰常导致训练困难。本文证明该困难源于传输问题本身，并给出推前映射梯度与雅可比的下界。重尾目标矩增大或多峰间低概率区都会迫使映射出现大梯度，揭示表达力与数值稳定性的权衡。作者进一步提出双射重参数化来缓解密度近似中的梯度负担，实验支持理论分析。
papers.abstract_en: Broad classes of deep generative models (DGMs) operate by learning to map a simple source distribution, such as a standard Gaussian, to a complex high-dimensional target distribution. Despite their success, DGMs often empirically struggle to accurately represent distributions with heavy tails or well-separated modes. In this work, we show that these difficulties reflect intrinsic properties of the underlying transport problem rather than particular neural network architectures or training procedures. We establish quantitative lower bounds on the gradients and Jacobians of pushforward mappings that transport log-concave source distributions to such targets. For heavy-tailed target distributions, the required gradient magnitude grows as the target develops increasingly large moments. For multimodal target distributions, the low-probability regions between well-separated modes similarly force large gradients in the transport map. We discuss how such large derivatives relate to trade-offs between expressivity and numerical stability. Our results hold under substantially weaker regularity conditions than previous analyses and remain stable under perturbations of the target distribution. Finally, we show that these obstructions can be mitigated when the goal is approximation of a given density rather than generative modeling. Specifically, we propose simple classes of bijective reparametrizations that can alleviate the difficult geometric structure and reduce the gradient burden placed on the learned generative map. Numerical experiments support our theoretical analysis.
